text.p: -- ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said Thursday it upgraded its rating on Sun Microsystems Inc to buy from hold because of recent weakness in the stock price caused by fears of an earnings shortfall.

-- ABN AMRO Chicago said it believes the potential revenue risk is only moderate, since the third quarter will be marked by high-volume shipments of high-margin Ultra Enterprise Server 10000 and high-end storage systems.
-- Sun Microsystems is also gaining market share in the commercial server market against its enterprise level competitors, ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said.
-- Sun Microsystems makes and markets high-performance computer workstations and servers.
-- Its shares were trading up 7/8 Thursday at 30-1/4.
